title: Classify Eight Controls by Type
prompt: For each control, choose the type that best describes its function over time. Note: the same tool can change type depending on how its use is described. Read the exact wording carefully.

items.label: Web application firewall that blocks a malicious request
Network IDS that alerts without blocking
Restoring a server from a verified backup
Rolling back a configuration after a failed change
Visible surveillance camera at the entrance

explain: Preventive = stops an action before it happens (firewall, MFA). Detective = identifies an event (IDS, log review). Corrective = restores after the event (backup restore, rollback). Deterrent = discourages through fear of consequences (visible camera, warning banner). A camera reviewed after the fact would be detective: the described use determines the category.
